name: start
description: Kick off or resume your custom content engine through a guided conversation and first batch.

name: next
description: Take the next useful step from saved progress, stopping for creator decisions.

name: progress
description: See where your engine stands, what is saved, and what to do next.

name: resume
description: Restore an unfinished kickoff, plan, or batch without starting over.

name: capture
description: Save real work, conversations, questions, and proof to your source library.

name: mine
description: Find distinct, cited topics in your real source material.

name: ideas
description: Search, organize, and select ideas from your content bank.

name: voice
description: Learn your voice from your own samples and review evidence-backed updates.

name: plan
description: Choose this week's topics, native formats, and content jobs.

name: create
description: Execute your saved editorial plan and resume until actual drafts are ready for review.

name: draft
description: Turn a source-backed idea into native content in your own voice.

name: article
description: Build a useful article with evidence and one structural framework.

name: week
description: Run or resume your weekly editorial team, ending with drafts for review.

name: review
description: Read, revise, and explicitly approve content before delivery.

name: publish
description: Deliver explicitly chosen content through a connector or guide manual publication.

name: analytics
description: Import measurements and learn what your content made people do.

name: compound
description: Develop a measured winner with fresh proof, context, story, argument, format, or utility.

name: status
description: See saved setup progress, drafts, pending work, and the next useful step.

name: help
description: Show CONTENTMAXXING abilities and suggest where to begin.
